headline: Starbucks China Rolls Out Nationwide 'Purchase Before Seating' Rule
summary: Starbucks China announced it will implement a mandatory 'purchase before seating' rule nationwide across its stores, following a similar policy introduced in North America.
why: Starbucks is a global coffeehouse chain relying heavily on its physical retail footprint and customer experience across key international growth markets like China.

impacts.name: Starbucks
impacts.why: Operational policy changes in key retail stores alter in-store traffic and table turnover dynamics.
